announce.isekai_mahou.star_devourer.intr: Another star entered my observatory... and stars, I DEVOUR.
announce.isekai_mahou.star_devourer.phas: The sky is hungry. Let it fall upon you!
Behold the end of all light: the void that swallows all!
boss.isekai_mahou.star_devourer.subtitle: The One Who Eats the Sky
command.isekai_mahou.end_library.located: Void Library in the End at X %s, Z %s.
command.isekai_mahou.end_library.no_end: The End does not exist on this server.
item.isekai_mahou.star_gear.requires: Only obeys those who reached Circle %s.
item.isekai_mahou.star_gear.set_bonus: Full set: night vision and Star Step (falling into the End's void returns you to solid ground).
item.isekai_mahou.star_upgrade_smithing_: Add netherite armor, weapon, or tool
item.isekai_mahou.void_overlord_staff.de: Seven golden serpents hold seven gems. The dead bow to whoever wields it.
item.isekai_mahou.void_overlord_staff.ne: Fall of the Sky requires Circle %s.
item.isekai_mahou.void_overlord_staff.no: No dead answer (undead summons are not present in this world).
item.isekai_mahou.void_overlord_staff.sk: You tear the sky open... look up!
The sky has not mended yet (%s s).
item.isekai_mahou.void_overlord_staff.us: Use: raises 3 allied Bone Warriors for 60 s (%s mana).
Sneak + use: Fall of the Sky — a pillar of light strikes where you aim (Circle %s, %s mana, 5 min cooldown).
item.isekai_mahou.void_tome.desc: A chained book from the Void Library. Something inside whispers about space.
item.isekai_mahou.void_tome.empty: The pages are blank. No glyph answered.
item.isekai_mahou.void_tome.use: Use: breaks the seal and reveals a spatial Glyph Scroll.
item.isekai_mahou.void_treasure_gate.des: The key to an endless treasury. The portals open behind you.
item.isekai_mahou.void_treasure_gate.use: Use: opens golden portals that fire weapons where you aim (%s mana; more weapons with your Circle).
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.boss.hi: Climb the Hall and Archive stairs to the Observatory. Phase 1: leave the gravity circles. Phase 2: meteors fall where you stand — keep moving. Phase 3: run out of the Black Hole before it collapses.
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.boss.lo: It eats stars. You look like one.
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.enter_e: Find the Stronghold with Eyes of Ender, light the portal and enter the End. The Library is on the OUTER islands: after the dragon, use the exit gateway (the small one, via ender pearl).
Beyond the Ender Dragon, the void has librarians.
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.find.hi: On the End's outer islands (highlands and midlands), look for a round purpur tower full of shelves, always on solid ground. The tracker points to the nearest one.
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.fragmen: Rare ore inside End stone on the outer islands (diamond pickaxe). Star Wisps and the chests also drop some.
Pieces of fallen stars no one saw fall.
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.intro: They say that beyond the Ender Dragon, on islands floating over nothingness, there is a library that keeps the secrets of space itself. Shall we read what the void wrote?
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.lore: A ruined tower of shelves on the End's outer islands. In the hall, hooded Scribes still copy books no one reads; in the Archive, chained tomes keep glyphs of space; and in the Observatory at the top, something enormous sleeps watching the stars — and eating them.
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.outro: The Devourer dissolves into a rain of light. For the first time in ages, the stars above the Library shine whole.
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.star_ge: Star Ingot = 4 Fragments + 2 gold + 1 diamond + 1 Eye of Ender. At the smithing table: Star Template + netherite piece + Ingot. Only obeys those at Circle 7.
The peak of what a smith can forge.
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.title: The Void Library
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.tome.hi: Chests in the Hall and the Archive (and sometimes Scribes) keep Sealed Tomes. Open one to reveal a spatial Glyph Scroll.
journal.isekai_mahou.end_library.tome.lo: Dimensional Inventory, portals, teleport... space has a grammar.
message.isekai_mahou.end_library.found: You found the Void Library. Endless shelves float above nothingness...
message.isekai_mahou.end_library.star_re: The star armor rejects you (requires Circle %s).
message.isekai_mahou.end_library.star_st: Star Step! The stars return you to solid ground.
message.isekai_mahou.end_library.star_to: The star gear does not obey (requires Circle %s).
message.isekai_mahou.star_devourer.black: The Black Hole pulls everything! Run OUT of the red circle before it collapses.
message.isekai_mahou.star_devourer.gravi: Leave the circle following you before it stops: whoever stays inside floats and is slammed down!
message.isekai_mahou.star_devourer.unrea: The Devourer crosses space to reach you!
